tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Antônio Villas Boas encounter in Brazil, in which he was taken aboard a craft by beings.

plain: A Brazilian man named Antonio Villas Boas said that in 1957 he was taken aboard a craft and had sex with a woman who looked almost human. A researcher named Mike Masters tells it on the show, saying Villas Boas described her as a woman who looked "a little bit different" from the women he knew, with "slightly higher cheekbones" and a "pointier chin." Michels mentions the case himself on a later episode in Brazil, placing it in the 1960s and leaving out the sex, as one of many cases where people seem to "interact with the beings and go up on the ships." For Masters, such a story would suggest the visitors are close kin to humans.
